archetypes.name: publish-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Step 5c publish now has several subtle success and failure path gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5c publish and final-summary changes for contract regressions. Focus on omitted versus explicit-empty session IDs, publish result rows, cleanup eligibility, and stale summary handling across rc 0, 1, 3, 4, and failure-tail paths. Check that stdout capture and final-summary emit semantics remain compatible with existing callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dynamic-panel
archetypes.rationale: Dynamic slot render failures now propagate through manifest and warning surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan-review panel dynamic slot failure handoff. Confirm fallback prompt rows stay launchable, execution-issues warnings are sanitized and categorized correctly, aggregate stdout warnings are compact, and static slot behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
